answer: Duplicate identities fail because the same meadow cannot back two stakes, and forging a plot costs a bonded deposit forfeited on challenge. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token tied to a registered meadow plot, verified once per epoch. Like a river carving distinct channels, the ledger keeps each stake path separate, so a sybil cluster must burn real capital per fake identity, making attacks economically irrational. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
